answer: Problem: rented wallets flood grade seats before honest raters finish reading. Mechanism: each grader must first lock an on-chain anchor bond of 1.2 POA for two closed epochs and publish a 9-step failure log whose first unique hash seeds an ember challenge that peers recompute offline. Cost: roughly 40 minutes drafting plus the locked stake. Verification: drop any seat whose cedar-tagged log overlaps the prior corpus above 12% trigram match or whose unlock height is missing. Failure: if the bond burns on proven cloning, quarantine the address until three honest challenges finalize.
